name: Asset
definition: Tangible items of value to a business.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date on which an order, a privilege, an entitlement or an offer terminates. For an interest bearing asset, it is the date/time at which it becomes due and has to be repaid.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Planned date, at the time of issuance, on which an interest bearing financial instrument becomes due and principal is repaid by the issuer to the investor.

InvestmentAmount.name: Investment Amount
InvestmentAmount.definition: Invested amount of the portfolio asset.

InvestmentRate.name: Investment Rate
InvestmentRate.definition: Invested percentage of the portfolio asset.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Cut off date/time for the information of the specified portfolio asset.

FinancialInstrumentSubStructure.name: Financial Instrument Sub Structure
FinancialInstrumentSubStructure.definition: Indicates the type of deal for structured finance.

ClearedGrossNotionalAmount.name: Cleared Gross Notional Amount
ClearedGrossNotionalAmount.definition: Gross notional amount that was cleared for that product on the report date.

Derivative.name: Derivative
Derivative.definition: Specifies the parameters of a derivative instrument based on a specific asset.

AssetValue.name: Asset Value
AssetValue.definition: Specifies the different values of an asset.

AssetPartyRole.name: Asset Party Role
AssetPartyRole.definition: Party which plays a role for a specific asset.

Issuance.name: Issuance
Issuance.definition: Details regarding the issuance of an asset.

Portfolio.name: Portfolio
Portfolio.definition: Asset which is part of a portfolio.

InvestmentPlan.name: Investment Plan
InvestmentPlan.definition: Investment plan that invests in a specific asset.

Trade.name: Trade
Trade.definition: Trade which which involves a specific asset.

Tranche.name: Tranche
Tranche.definition: One of a number of related assets offered as part of the same transaction.

StandingSettlementInstruction.name: Standing Settlement Instruction
StandingSettlementInstruction.definition: Standing settlement instruction for which an asset is specified.
